channel.title: GlassGrid You
channel.description: Most recent releases of GlassGrid You for macOS.

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
What's New in GlassGrid You 1.3.1

  • FairPlay DRM Playback Hardening: Switches Disney+, Netflix, and Hulu to passive FairPlay-safe passthrough and keeps strict-DRM & YouTube TV tiles unmasked cleanly in windowed, Multiview, and Mini-Player playback.
  • Per-Tile Multiview Volume Mixer: Adjust any tile independently (0%–100%) from a dark-HUD popover or the Floating Grid's Stream Volumes sliders, with active-focus & 15% background ducking preservation and 1-click Reset Mix.
  • Floating Mini-Player Resizing & Polish: Added smooth 8-edge & corner drag resizing, direct Shrink (−) / Expand (+) header controls, new XL presets (880×495 Single / 1040×585 Grid), exact 1.25× / 1.75× speed labels, and high-contrast Day/Night popovers.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's New in GlassGrid You 1.3.0

  • Compact Single-Row Header (⌘⌥\) & Unified “+” Picker: Collapse stacked header chrome into one 52pt Liquid Glass bar with inline tabs, Smart Omnibox morphing, a compact ⊞ N Multiview pill, Split Screen folding, and an Add to Grid / New Tab catalog covering all 18 services and 8 Sports/Fantasy/Markets sites.
  • Live Pulse (Opt-In · ⌘⌥B / ⌘⌥I): Live NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL scoreboards ranked by #1–#4 Sport Priority or Watched Stream Focus, Sleeper & ESPN Public Fantasy tracking with Starter vs. Bench cues, strictly read-only Kalshi & Polymarket odds, 15s freshness + manual refresh, and 0s/20s/35s Spoiler Delay buffering.
  • 18-Service Hub, Universal Clean-Box (⌘⇧B) & Floating Multiview Grid: Added Crunchyroll, hardened Prime Video/Disney+/HBO Max auth isolation, automatic player Clean-Box across all 18 services, and full 2–4 stream Floating Multiview Grids.
  • Seasonal Holiday Color Themes & Ambient Effects: Offline calendar detection across 9 WCAG 2.1 AA Day & Night palettes (Thanksgiving Harvest, Winter Holidays, New Year’s, Valentine’s, St. Patrick’s, Spring & Easter, July 4th, Halloween, and Classic Crimson) with chrome-only WindowServer Core Animation effects.
  • Inter v4.1 Design System & Local AI Control: Bundled offline Inter v4.1 typography with WCAG 2.1 AA Day/Night contrast and Reduce Transparency adaptation, plus opt-in local MCP server (28 tools), glassgrid CLI, and 12 Siri App Intents.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's New in GlassGrid You 1.2.0

  • Streaming Service Onboarding & Sign-In Hub: Pick from 17 major services on first launch and sign in directly with full OAuth popup support and clear Safari DRM badges where studios restrict third-party WebViews.
  • 1-Click “Add Screen” Service Picker: Add any selected service, open tab, or custom URL straight into your 1–4 stream Multiview grid, Sidebar Services section, or Command Palette (⌘K).
  • Pro Multiview Controls: Zero-latency Solo/Expand tile (⌘⌥Z / Esc) without reloading background streams, plus Live Stream Sync micro-nudge (-5s, -1s, +1s, +5s, and Jump to Live).
  • Floating Mini-Player Opacity & Shadow DOM Controls: Adjustable 40%–100% glass opacity slider, universal companion pop-out, and Shadow DOM playback/speed support across Peacock, Disney+, Max, and Apple TV+.
  • Native macOS AirPlay Suite & Per-Service Login Reset: Stream video via AirPlay, route audio output, move your window or 4-stream wall to any External or AirPlay Display, and reset logins cleanly per service.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in GlassGrid You 1.1.1

  • Unified macOS Liquid Glass Titlebar: Crisp 52pt unified titlebar alignment keeps traffic-light buttons concentrically inset inside the floating Liquid Glass sidebar with zero corner clipping across Light and Dark modes.
  • Native Fullscreen Polish: Seamless toolbar handoff on notched MacBook Pro displays ensures the sidebar header and top controls (including Multiview) stay cleanly visible below the bezel.
  • Multi-Window & Sparkle 2 Auto-Updates: Independent macOS windows (⌘N), draggable 120Hz Multiview tile dividers, Companion Web Tiles (Twitch, ESPN, NFL.com, Prime Video), Sidebar Channel Folders, and silent EdDSA-verified Sparkle updates.
